name: Let B_n = {b_1 < b_2 < ...} be the set of those integers in [n, n^2] which have a divisor in (n, 2n). a(n) = max(b_(i+1) - b_i).
link: William Alexander Carney, Table of n, a(n) for n = 3..1000
Paul Erdős, Some unconventional problems in number theory, Astérisque no. 61 (1979), 73-82.
author: _Elijah Beregovsky_, Dec 28 2025
